checks_detail.name: Energy Balance Check
checks_detail.detail: Charge/discharge energy integral consistency; coulombic efficiency within 95-105% per cycle.

checks_detail.name: Capacity Monotonicity
checks_detail.detail: Degradation trajectory follows expected non-increasing trend with allowable recovery windows.

checks_detail.name: Temperature Consistency
checks_detail.detail: Cell surface temperature stays within 5C of the stated test condition.

checks_detail.name: Timestamp Integrity
checks_detail.detail: Monotonically increasing timestamps with no negative intervals or gaps above 24h.

checks_detail.name: Current Direction Consistency
checks_detail.detail: Charge and discharge current signs follow one convention throughout the dataset.
